simple.meaning: שָׁתָה (shâthâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to imbibe (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 217 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 6 more, beginning at Genesis 9:21. Its contexts include family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁתָה (H8354).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׁתָה (shâthâh) / H8354 is traced through Genesis 9:21, Genesis 24:14, Genesis 24:18, Genesis 24:19 as a generated source-based concept entry.
